title: Chand nahi, Karwa line ka number!
format: Kitty Gang festival-moment parody at the theme's Housie

experiment.hook: 3 gang faces on the Karwa Katha home art looking up at the night sky, the mascot ball spinning in place of the moon, banner 'Karwa Chauth ka asli intezaar'
experiment.variable: the hook is the festival's own iconic moment (waiting to spot the moon) instead of a Housie situation, with the mascot ball standing in for the moon
experiment.hypothesis: a moment every Karwa Chauth viewer is living that same night stops the swipe: skip under 60%, watched % above 22, at least 2 shares

idea: On Karwa Chauth the gang keeps looking up, but Tanya is not waiting for the moon, she is waiting for her last Karwa line number, and Ishita claims it first.
beats: hook: everyone looking up, ball as the moon / setup: chand nahi, Karwa line ka number / esc: 27 nahi aaya, Aditi deadpan, Ruhi's tip / turn: 44 comes, Ishita claims first / button: Aditi, agla chand saade baarah baje
caption: {theme} Housie: aaj aap chand ka wait kar rahe ho ya apne last number ka? Us saheli ko tag karo jo dono karti hai!

lines.text: Chand nahi, Karwa line ka number!
lines.say: चाँद नहीं, करवा लाइन का नंबर!

lines.text: Chand bhi itna wait nahi karata.
lines.say: चाँद भी इतना वेट नहीं कराता।

lines.text: Maine toh suna hai, agla pakka!
lines.say: मैंने तो सुना है, अगला पक्का!

lines.text: Hmm. Agla chand saade baarah baje.
lines.say: हम्म। अगला चाँद साढ़े बारह बजे।
